name: claude-council
description: Consult multiple AI coding agents (Gemini, OpenAI, Grok, Perplexity, Kimi, any model OpenRouter routes to, plus codex, antigravity, grok, kimi and cursor CLIs when installed, and a local ollama model) to get diverse perspectives on coding problems, with a streaming pane in tmux or inside Claude Code, and, once switched on, a heads-up side-check where one council seat, codex by default, rereads a long turn and shows one line above the prompt about something you may have missed. It can also hand a coding task to a Codex specialist that works on its own git branch and follows skills you pick (experimental).

pane_host.title: Pane opens in
pane_host.description: One of: ask, claude-code, tmux. Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. claude-code draws the pane inside Claude Code; tmux leaves it to the tmux pane; ask puts the question once inside tmux and remembers the answer.

collapse_when_done.title: Collapse status when done
collapse_when_done.description: Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. Replace the provider list with a one-line summary once a run finishes.

wake_on_async_done.title: Wake on async finish
wake_on_async_done.description: Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. Submit a prompt when a background council run completes. Starts a model turn, which costs tokens.

council_tool.title: Council as a tool
council_tool.description: Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. Let the model call the council as a tool. Every call first asks you to confirm, because the council sends the question to third-party providers.

specialist_round_limit.title: Specialist round limit (minutes)
specialist_round_limit.description: Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. A specialist round still running after this many minutes is stopped, and nothing it did is committed. Fractions count to the second. 0 means no limit.

heads_up.title: Heads-up side-check
heads_up.description: Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. While Claude works a long turn, one council seat, codex by default, rereads the last five turns and the last eight tool results and may show one line above the prompt. Nothing asks before a send: that material leaves the machine on every check. A project's .claude/council-heads-up.json can turn it on or off for that project alone and pick the seat and cadence.

specialists.title: Specialists
specialists.description: Experimental: applies only when Claude Code runs with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1. Set up with /specialists; this field holds what it saves, as a JSON list of objects, and /config does not show it.
